meta.instruction: The player's chosen Primary Attribute (STR, DEX, or INT) determines their starting civilization and quest line.
meta.usage: Ingest the specific key matching the player's stat to retrieve the narrative path.

quests.title: The Isotope Sabotage
quests.narrative_guidance: The Refinery's security has detected a leak that isn't accidental. Trace the stolen isotopes.
improvisation_points: Consult with Refinery-Sec Drax about the missing isotopes in Argent-Thrive.
Meet Watchman Silas at Sentinel Ridge to track the thief's escape path.
Apprehend Splicer-Novice Riven in the Splicing Chambers before the isotopes are consumed.

quests.title: The Holy Mutation
quests.narrative_guidance: Mother Spore requires a specific strain of lead-resistant flora to complete a ritual.
improvisation_points: Receive the ritual requirements from Deacon Spore at the Neon Cathedral.
Acquire the experimental seeds from Gardener Lys at the Lead-Glass Canopy.
Deliver the finalized samples to Vault-Keep Tor for safe storage in the Obsidian Vaults.

quests.title: Crimson Smuggle
quests.narrative_guidance: Korr Malek needs a shipment of isotopic pollen moved across borders without the Exarch knowing.
improvisation_points: Pick up the pollen stash from Slinker Korr in the Rad-Worker Shanty.
Bribe or bypass Gatekeeper Kragg at the Tungsten Gate of Lead-Fastness.
Deliver the goods to Lume-Stalker Zek in the Bioluminescent Alleys.

quests.title: Grit-Iron Trials
quests.narrative_guidance: The Concordat needs a champion to test the new mutagenic enhancement serum in combat.
improvisation_points: Enroll in the trials with Drillmaster Gort at the Grit-Iron Training Grounds.
Acquire the 'Performance Enhancers' from Trader Jool at the Kinetic Market.
Demonstrate the serum's power to Culler-Chief Yorrik at Gene-Cullers' Walk.

quests.title: Archivist's Preservation
quests.narrative_guidance: A rare mutation is dying out, and its genetic code must be carved into bone before it fades.
improvisation_points: Receive the preservation task from Scribe Juno at the Transmutation Spire.
Locate the dying specimen using the aerial data from Scout-Major Nix.
Use the heavy-machinery of Dredge-Worker Milo to extract the specimen safely.

quests.title: The Heavy-Water Deal
quests.narrative_guidance: A dispute over water rights is slowing production in the refinery.
improvisation_points: Negotiate terms with Dockmaster Vane at the Heavy-Water Docks.
Secure an escort from Knight-Captain Harl to ensure the shipment's safety.
Deliver the purified water to Font-Guard Kael to stabilize the Isotope Font.

quests.title: Mutagen Harvest
quests.narrative_guidance: The gardens are over-producing, and the excess energy must be channeled into armor plating.
improvisation_points: Harvest the excess mutagen from Bloom-Tender Elara in the Mutagen Gardens.
Filter the mutagenic sludge with Scav-Chief Rek in the Sulphur Flats.
Apply the coating to the infantry shields under the supervision of Sergeant Brawn.

quests.title: Harvest Crimson Spores
quests.narrative_guidance: Collect rare Crimson Bloom spores for a weapons experiment while avoiding the heavy radiation of the refinery.
improvisation_points: Meet Riven-88 at the refinery to obtain a radiation-shielded container.
Deliver the container to Mother Spore to have it filled with consecrated spores.
Bring the filled container to Dr. Lys Arkan for final processing.

quests.title: The Isotopic Run
quests.narrative_guidance: Smuggle a batch of refined isotopic pollen past the local sentries to the market.
improvisation_points: Receive the pollen package from Korr Malek in the Scrapyard.
Bribe or bypass Sentry Glass-Eye at the Lead-Glass Atrium.
Hand off the package to Trader Dax at the Spectral-Cusp Market.

quests.title: The Holy Mutation
quests.narrative_guidance: Facilitate the ritualistic growth of a new fungal strain that mirrors the Bloom Child's nature.
improvisation_points: Obtain a starter seed from Gardener Sol's Echoing Greenhouse.
Introduce the seed to the Bloom Child to be enriched by their spore cloud.
Record the resulting mutation's data with Archivist Juno.

quests.title: Sabotage the Reactor
quests.narrative_guidance: Infiltrate the cooling system to disrupt a rival's isotope production.
improvisation_points: Coordinate with Riven-88 to identify the weak point in the reactor.
Swim through the Cooling Canal with Diver Myra to plant the disruptive device.
Escalate the confusion by reporting a false emergency to Loader Brix.

quests.title: The Child's Shield
quests.narrative_guidance: Ensure the Bloom Child is safely transported to the Gardens while under threat from dissenters.
improvisation_points: Escort The Bloom Child from the refinery through the Bone-Lichen Fields.
Defend the path alongside Prism-Guard Val near the Refraction Plaza.
Safe delivery to Gardener Sol in the Echoing Greenhouse.

quests.title: Yorrik's Salvation
quests.narrative_guidance: Attempt to stabilize Foreman Yorrik's rapidly mutating body using heavy water treatments.
improvisation_points: Retrieve a request for help from a delirious Foreman Yorrik.
Collect high-purity heavy water from Pumper Finn.
Deliver the water to Carver Rhia to create a localized obsidian cooling chamber.

quests.title: The Bone Chronicle
quests.narrative_guidance: Help Archivist Juno preserve the memory of a collapsing mutation found in the reservoirs.
improvisation_points: Consult Archivist Juno to identify which bone tablets are needed.
Retrieve a 'living' sample from Dredger Kael at the Chrono-Silt Reservoirs.
Bring the sample to Weaver Lyss to have its spectral patterns woven into a permanent record.

quests.title: The Isotope Smuggle
quests.narrative_guidance: Transport illegal isotopic pollen from the flats to the core labs for clandestine study.
improvisation_points: Recover the pollen cache from Tracker Korr in the Polonium Flats.
Secure passage through the docks with Docker Jax's assistance.
Deliver the sample to Sidera in Core Lab Alpha for analysis.

quests.title: The Holy Mutation
quests.narrative_guidance: Preserve and record the emergence of a new biological strain within the Spires.
improvisation_points: Receive the record tablets from Archivist Juno at Pharmanon Heights.
Obtain the sanctified bismuth from Monk Silas to protect the tablets.
Observe and record the Bloom Child's latest growth in the Gardens.

quests.title: Heart-Reactor Sabotage
quests.narrative_guidance: Disrupt the cooling systems to force a recalibration of the city's power grid.
improvisation_points: Obtain the override codes from Sentinel Riven.
Access the fission controls via Voron in Fission Plaza.
Disable the primary cooling pumps monitored by Elara.

quests.title: Fungal Data Retrieval
quests.narrative_guidance: Extract raw data from a mutated spore cluster and synthesize it into a digital format.
improvisation_points: Deploy the scrubbing probes provided by Pax in the Data-Scrub Wards.
Extract the spore samples from Spore-Warden Mira's enrichment spines.
Synthesize the final data package with Alchemist Vex in Synthesis Square.

quests.title: The Lead-Glass Catalyst
quests.narrative_guidance: Craft a reinforced lead-glass lens to focus gamma rays for botanical acceleration.
improvisation_points: Retrieve the tempered glass mold from Kaelen at the Lead-Glass Atrium.
Harden the mold using the gamma-tide currents at Goyle's harbor.
Apply the lens to Botanist Lys's glowing gardens in the Thallium Groves.

quests.title: Cure the Veins
quests.narrative_guidance: Develop a serum to slow the lethal radiation poisoning affecting the harvest workers.
improvisation_points: Collect blood samples from Foreman Yorrik's glowing veins.
Process the samples with Apothecary Zoya to create a mutagenic buffer.
Administer the final serum to Dr. Aris in Quarantine Sector 9 for mass production.

quests.title: Scintillation Harvesting
quests.narrative_guidance: Capture pure light-energy from the fields and store it in the high-density vaults.
improvisation_points: Calibrate the light-catchers with Scintillator Krell in the fields.
Escort the energy canisters past the vault security managed by Vane.
Analyze the energy frequency with Watcher Sol at the Observation Spire.
